violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the prep area was lacking proper hand washing signage. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026
Inspector observed various items from an unapproved source. PIC disposed or embargoed items. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

Rice and couscous puddings were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026
Per interview with PIC, establishment makes juice beverages. PIC informed stop making juices until approved by RIDOH. PIC disposed of juice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

Various items packaged in the food establishment are lacking complete labels. Food packaged in a food establishment must be labeled with the common name of the food, a list of ingredients (including allergens), the quantity of the contents, and the business name/address. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026
Various items were observed displayed as customer self-service without protection from contamination by consumer. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026
Inspector observed various items stored in non-food grade plastic. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: - freezer units - chest freezers - open case coolers - shelves in the prep unit New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The floors in the prep area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 05/14/2026

The walls in the hand sink area (prep room) are constructed of dry wall. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 05/31/2026
The floors in the retail and prep room areas are in poor repair (need resealing). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/30/2026

Wood is used in the construction of (platform for chest freezer) in the (retail) area. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 09/23/2024
The door to the (unisex ) toilet room is not self-closing. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 01/12/2024
The door to the unisex toilet room is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 01/12/2024
